zh.title: 优化
items: **计划卡片改为无边框悬浮设计**：移除执行中计划与历史计划的明显实体描边，使用表面层级、柔和阴影和留白建立更轻盈的卡片层次。
**计划卡片交互反馈更自然**：补充默认、悬停和按下状态的语义化阴影，并适配暗色主题、键盘焦点和减少动效偏好。
**执行中计划默认展开**：重新进入会话或恢复任务后，当前活动计划直接展示目标、任务进度与执行轨迹，减少重复展开操作。
**全屏提问浮层布局优化**：调整问题确认界面的对齐与视觉层级，使操作焦点更明确。

zh.title: 修复
items: 修复模型流式请求暂时失败后，Goal Runner 可能停止推进、无法继续执行剩余任务的问题。
修复活动计划在部分状态恢复场景中没有自动展开的问题。

en.title: Improvements
items: **Borderless floating plan cards**: Removed heavy outlines on active and historical plans; surface layers, soft shadows, and spacing create a lighter hierarchy.
**More natural plan-card feedback**: Semantic shadows for default / hover / pressed, with dark theme, keyboard focus, and reduced-motion support.
**Active plans expand by default**: Re-entering a session or resuming work shows goal, task progress, and run trace immediately.
**Fullscreen question overlay layout**: Clearer alignment and visual hierarchy for confirmations.

en.title: Fixes
items: Fixed Goal Runner stopping after a temporary model stream failure and failing to continue remaining tasks.
Fixed active plans not auto-expanding after some state restore paths.
